name_zh: WQ101 Alpha46 收盘斜率状态
formula_zh: 收盘价20/10期斜率状态，带 -delta(close,1) 分支
intuition_en: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 21h bars.
intuition_zh: 源自WQ101论文的Alpha公式，适配21小时K线。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Direction intentionally left conditional to avoid post-hoc fitting. Empirical diagnostics required.
expected_direction_explanation_zh: 方向故意设为条件式以避免事后拟合。需实证诊断。
known_limitations_en: Slope thresholds are transferred from daily equities to 1h crypto bars and may produce state-like constants.
known_limitations_zh: 斜率阈值从日频股票迁移到1小时加密K线，可能产生状态型常数输出。
horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 21 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
horizon_notes_zh: 回溯窗口：21根K线。评价覆盖1h/4h/24h/72h视野。
status_explanation_en: Status: DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE. Diagnostic probe — not yet promoted to active signal.
status_explanation_zh: 状态：DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE。诊断探针——尚未升级为活跃信号。
qa_notes_zh: 源自WQ101论文的Alpha公式，适配21小时K线。
qa_notes_en: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 21h bars.
main_strengths_zh: 计算完整性(90); 稳定性(83)
main_weaknesses_zh: 组合提取能力(54); 方向可解释性(30)
review_notes_zh: 元数据质量: NEEDS_REVIEW; 需人工审查公式或元数据; QA: 源自WQ101论文的Alpha公式，适配21小时K线。
review_notes_en: Metadata quality: NEEDS_REVIEW; Formula or metadata needs human review; QA: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 21h bars.
review_subreason_zh: 主要是批量接入后的元数据/解释待补齐，不等于因子失效。
review_subreason_en: Mainly metadata/explanation cleanup after bulk intake; not evidence that the factor failed.
ml_gate_reason_zh: 可作为候选特征进入机器学习，但带元数据风险标记。
ml_gate_reason_en: Eligible as an ML candidate feature with a metadata risk flag.
main_diagnostic_note_zh: 中等表现，需结合其他指标评估
main_diagnostic_note_en: Moderate performance, evaluate with other metrics
